locations.section: Transparency in the Use of AI Tools
locations.quote: In preparing this proposal, I made use of several AI-based tools across different stages of the writing process. For grammar and style correction, I used Grammarly to identify grammatical errors, improve sentence structure, and refine the overall writing style of my drafts. For translation and language enhancement, I used DeepL to translate passages between German and English and to improve the fluency of phrasings. For content generation and idea expansion, I used ChatGPT, OpenAI Codex, Claude, and Claude Code to reformulate sentences I had already drafted, expand on ideas I had outlined, and obtain suggestions for clearer phrasing. For coding assistance, I used GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, OpenAI Codex, Claude, and Claude Code to support Typst formatting, generate snippets for figures and macros, and resolve template-related issues. For citation assistance, I used Zotero to manage my references and to ensure proper citation formatting throughout the proposal. I have carefully checked all texts created with these tools to ensure that they are correct and make sense.
